_comment: src/assets/objects/wood_carving.png を作り直すためのレシピ。build.py が読む。
太い枝1本から刃物だけで削り出した小さな像（src/assets/world-codex/furnishings.yaml）。
**細さを落とすNGワードを足してはいけない。** 1周目が細い操り人形になったので stick figure /
artist mannequin / thin limbs などを足したところ、8枚とも人の形が消えて枯れ木と板になった
（prompts/objects.json の thick_branch と同じ壊れ方）。**ずんぐりさは本文の側だけで言う。**
**足元の台は編集で外す。** 生成は像を切り株や枝の上へ載せたがる。載せたままだと、札の上では
台のほうが大きく写って像に見えない。
**mode: flood で抜く**（4つの設えで共通。recipes/branch_table.json に理由を書いた）。
段は256。設えの中で唯一小さい物（300g）なので、石と同じ段に置いて他の3つと見分ける。

edit.prompt: Repaint this picture as a soft hand painted illustration on a plain empty white page. Keep the same little wooden figure standing upright in the same place at the same angle, but carve the whole of it out of one solid piece of branch. Thicken its arms and legs until each of them is as thick as the branch itself, so that they read as blunt stumps growing straight out of the body: there is no thin stick, no wire and no gap anywhere on the figure, and the legs meet the ground as one wide solid base. Give it a rounded knob for a head with a plain blank front and no face, and a stout barrel body. Cover the whole figure in broad flat facets left by a knife blade, with the cut marks plainly visible, so that it looks hacked out of dry wood rather than turned or sanded, and give it no paint, no varnish and no shine. Take away the branch, the log and everything else it is standing on, so that the figure stands directly on the page. Remove the background completely and replace it with a plain empty white page, leaving the figure alone in the middle with a wide white margin all around it and one soft grey shadow on the ground beneath it. Everything in the picture is clearly darker than the white page, and nothing has a white outline, a pale rim or a glow around it. Warm mid brown wood, dry matte surface, flat even lighting. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature.
